contour_semantics: For each nonempty TrueType contour, if the first raw point is on-curve it is the start; otherwise if the last is on-curve it is the start; otherwise their exact midpoint is the start. Traversal preserves raw point and contour order. Each contour emits exactly one Move first and one Close last, resets pending state, and never emits a redundant Line back to the start. Empty glyphs emit no commands.
implied_point_semantics: Every circular adjacent off-curve pair, including the self-pair of a one-point off-curve contour, creates one logical exact on-curve midpoint. Midpoints are computed from already fully transformed and attached real controls as exact (a+b)/2. They never participate in compound point attachment, and numerically equal points remain distinct logical points.
command_semantics: An on-curve point with no pending control emits Line; an on-curve point with a pending off-curve control emits Quad and clears it; consecutive off-curve points emit Quad to their exact midpoint and retain the latter control; a final pending control emits Quad to the start. Move and Line carry one point, Quad carries control then endpoint, and Close carries none. Degenerate, duplicate, zero-length and zero-area commands are retained. Op tags are Move=1, Line=2, Quad=3, Close=4.
rounding_semantics: Every real or implied logical point is rounded exactly once from normalized exact dyadic font-space coordinates to signed Q26.6 using symmetric nearest-even. Midpoints are formed before rounding; already-rounded endpoints are never averaged. Exact midpoint addition gates aligned temporary numerators before shifting. Because accepted source coordinates are within signed-int16 bbox range but may have different denominator shifts, this stage permits the source exact-bit ceiling plus 16 bits (528 default, 4112 hard) for the proved worst alignment growth. No float, big.Rat, clamp, wrap, saturation, post-round simplification or host rounding is allowed. Q26.6 remains y-up font space.
source_binding_semantics: The immutable GeometryFont receipt and compact glyph metadata are checked against profile constants and receipt-only resource formulas. The retained OutlineFont graph is recounted and rehashed, every glyph is expanded exactly once, bbox/metric declarations and compact metadata are recomputed, and the complete source geometry hash is replayed before publication.
descriptor_hash_semantics: The descriptor hash is SHA-256 over u64be(len(descriptor_hash_profile)) followed by its exact UTF-8 bytes, then u64be(len(canonical_descriptor_json)) followed by the exact minified encoding/json bytes of this ordered map-free descriptor. It is lowercase hex with the sha256: prefix.
hash_semantics: The outline-set hash is streaming SHA-256 over the declared preimage. str is u64be UTF-8 byte length plus exact bytes; u8, u32 and u64 are fixed-width big-endian; i64 is its two's-complement uint64 bit pattern. Arrays remain in glyph, contour and command order. No JSON, map, native integer or float enters the preimage.

ownership_semantics: The call borrows GeometryFont and retained source data. Success owns a flat exact-size command array and per-glyph scalar ranges, retains the immutable source for provenance, exposes only indexed value views, creates no mutable cache, and supports concurrent reads.
cancellation_semantics: A non-nil context is checked before work, through source graph and geometry revalidation, flag topology, exact expansion, every contour, rounding, hashing and immediately before publication. Cancellation publishes nil and a zero receipt.
failure_semantics: Invalid source bindings, topology or arity drift, coordinate/exact/resource overflow, cancellation, allocation failure and invariant failure return nil OutlineSet and a strictly zero receipt.
capability_semantics: This stage materializes all-glyph font-space outlines only. It does not validate layout tables or shaping and does not advertise cutly.text.pinned-font-viewport-px.v2 or any Text capability.
excluded_responsibilities: GDEF/GSUB/GPOS validation or execution, cmap-to-run shaping, bidi, fallback, go-text/HarfBuzz, textlayout assembly, scaling to viewport pixels, flattening, raster, paint, compositing, encoding, persistence and publication are outside this profile.
